acceptance.text: First-occurrence parking: a question or blocked yield opens the attention on its first occurrence without consuming a try. Today only YieldHumanChoice and YieldHumanConfirmation route to the human park (the kind test at internal/runtime/turn_recovery.go:1343-1356); question and blocked fall into the automation loop, whose only forwardable fact on this path is the literal string 'no sealed submission' (the eligible-facts gate at internal/driver/automation.go:205-230 against the three facts built at turn_recovery.go:871-893) - repeated up to a 10,000-action budget. Pinned by turn-recovery tests: one question yield produces one open attention and an unconsumed try. Evidence basis: sworn#191 - two of three tries burned before an answerable attention surfaced, and the same correct guard implementation was written three times and survived nowhere.

The worker's words reach the operator verbatim: the opened attention carries the yield's own message as its question (the park machinery already does this - parkTurnRecoveryReplacingBound passes the message through at turn_recovery.go:2266-2277, and the board's needs-you row surfaces attention questions verbatim at internal/cockpit/catalog.go:101-119) - pinned by a test asserting the question text end to end.

The answer resumes the same conversation: the park retains the worker's continuation (the retention at turn_recovery.go:2306-2314), the answered attention resumes the yielded worker with the answer in place, and the park survives host death recoverable through the existing paths - the durability posture of the park checkpoint is chosen deliberately and pinned (the human-park variant persists a crash-barrier checkpoint at turn_recovery.go:1820-1892 and the plain variant does not; an answerable park that dies with its host would re-burn exactly the work this slice protects). Pinned by a yield-park-answer-resume fixture including a host-death crash cut.

Escalation stays possible: a worker that yields blocked repeatedly after answers, or whose question genuinely cannot be answered, still reaches the existing park-for-human and exhaustion paths - first-occurrence parking never becomes an infinite ask-answer loop; a bounded ask count per work is pinned by test.

constraints: The yield vocabulary is settled (internal/driver/yield.go:19-26): this slice changes where question and blocked route, never what they mean; human-only kinds keep their stricter durable-checkpoint semantics.
The captain-advisory path (RecoveryAskCaptain) remains available before the park where the model elects it; what dies is the content-free resume loop as the default fate of an honest question.
Evidence anchor for the cost: docs/captures/2026-08-11-sworn-engine-recording-dogfood-defects.md F16.
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.
